title: docmeta docs page frontmatter
description: Requires every published docs page to declare a non-empty title and description. This is the house rule only: it exists because Starlight itself does not require `description` and this site does. The Starlight keys (sidebar, template, hero, and the rest) are constrained by the `astro:starlight:0.41` built-in, which the docs workflow validates alongside this file. Do not restate those fields here — two definitions of one key is the drift this pairing avoids.
